desc: The image shows a classic vada pav—a deep-fried spiced potato fritter (vada) tucked inside a soft pav bun, served with green chutney and dry garlic chutney. Widely considered Mumbai’s most beloved street food, vada pav is affordable, flavorful, and quick to eat on the go. Often sold at roadside stalls across Maharashtra, it’s a vegetarian snack with bold flavors and a cult following. The photo captures the crispy texture and vibrant accompaniments that define this iconic Indian dish.
